description: Browsing history structural guardrails for Flutter-compatible design specs.

forbiddenSelectors.message: Legacy chiprow markup must not return; history cards use Result-card style row badges.
Sort/filter bars are not part of the browsing-history screen contract.
Selection check affordances are not part of history cards.
Preview panes are forbidden; the Flutter data model has no preview panel for this screen.
External Material Symbols font usage is forbidden in this HTML design repository.
iPad empty state belongs in the content pane, not the tab/filter pane.
iPhone compact tabs must stay fixed outside the scroll area.
iPhone landscape tabs must stay fixed outside the scroll area.

requiredSelectors.message: The forbidden-patterns section must remain documented.
Phone empty state must be inside the scrollable content area, not replacing fixed tabs.
iPad portrait empty state must render in the right/content pane.
iPad landscape empty state must render in the right/content pane.

forbiddenDescendants.message: Disease history rows must mirror Result cards and must not render an image tile.

requiredDirectParent.message: Bulk-delete FAB must be positioned consistently relative to the device, not nested in scroll panes.
